notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
Minimap Arrow to show incoming waves direction (solo player)

Bug fix :
- Fix camera starting position (Multiplayer)
- Unit keep attacking after attack target has been set
- Building placement no longer require to keep the  left  mouse button pushed

notes.title: Solo Player Added
notes.notes:
Player can now play alone vs waves of enemies 

Bug fix :
-Fix a bug with units stop autoattacking when they had a target.
- The mouse overlay now displays if a unit will attack or move


Added a cancel button to cancel unit production

notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.notes:
[u][b]Bug fix :[/b][/u]

-fix a bug where the mouse size was affected by the screen resolution
-fix a bug where the movement and attack icon appeared for one forame before it was moved
-bug fix attempt to prevent  all unit to stay selected on some computer/ screen resolution 
-unit movement now stop more fluidly
-fix a bug where the canon death animation wasn't playing properly

notes.title: Bug Fix and middle map reward
notes.notes:
Bug fixe:

-Fix a bug were players couldn't select their units on some screen resolution.

Features:
- A Jack Pot is now located in the middle of the map to give an insentive to occupy and compete for the center of the map

notes.title: Targeting system improvement
notes.notes:
Bug fix: units are no longer stuck attacking buildings when ordered to move away.

Balancing: canons have now more life a little bit more accuracy
